5691.title: ACP launch settings discard non-restorable sessions
5691.rootCauseOneLine: Launch settings rebuild the live ACP process without checking whether its conversation can be restored.
5691.proposedFix: Reject destructive launch model/reasoning changes before stopping a non-restorable live session.
5691.caveats: Verified using the trusted fake ACP agent in two clean production checkouts, not the third-party agent or macOS.
